descriptions.d20d_text_range_width_8018c938: Width of part of a laid-out text line: return the float at 0x803a7e30 when 'start' exceeds the glyph count (0x8018ca1c); otherwise sum the glyph values of at most 'count' glyph references from 'start' up to the end of the line, starting from that float, multiply by the text size at +36 and divide by the weight of the first track's first glyph. Field meanings are inferred.
